name: clean-voice-prompt
description: Cleans voice-dictated prompts before they are sent: drops um, uh, filler like and you know, lead-ins and stuttered repeats, never touching code, paths, quotes, commands or numbers.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto cleans and sends, with a short receipt; review puts the cleaned prompt back in the box for you to send; off leaves prompts alone.

level.title: How much to cut
level.description: standard removes hesitations, filler like and you know, lead-ins and repeats; aggressive also removes actually, literally, honestly, obviously and essentially when set off by commas.

receipt.title: Show a receipt
receipt.description: After a prompt is cleaned, show a short pop-up with what was saved.

bridge.title: Clean Remote Control prompts
bridge.description: Also clean prompts sent from the phone or web through Remote Control (always auto: there is no box to review in).
